description: Shared supplier-alias table for the 12 Lancashire districts. JV and arms-length entities carry different ledger names across districts (e.g. Barnfield Construction vs Barnfield Investment Properties vs Pearl 2) — this file is the canonical cross-reference so each district's record_classification.json + DOGE cross-council analyses treat them as a single legal entity. Each group lists the canonical name, known aliases across councils, and a reason note.

groups.reason: Barnfield group operating entity. Appears in Burnley as BARNFIELD INVESTMENT PROPERTIES (JV shell), in Pendle as PEARL 2, in Blackburn as BARNFIELD CONSTRUCTION. Cross-council analysis must merge these — the real trading entity is Barnfield Construction Ltd.

Development-manager subsidiary of Eric Wright Group. Pioneer Place + Charter Walk + council-property forward-funding. FRS 102 s33.1A exemption means inter-company flows from Maple Grove to Eric Wright Construction are invisible at Companies House; cross-reference via group accounts instead.
Operating construction arm of Eric Wright Group. Wholly-owned subsidiary of Eric Wright Group Ltd. Files full 41-page accounts (unlike the JV shells which file total exemption).

Sub-regional economic-development body chaired by Tim Webber. Oversees procurement frameworks for Pennine Lancashire districts. Councillors from 4 Barnfield-JV councils (Burnley, Blackburn, Pendle, Hyndburn) sit on its board — structural conflict to track.

Housing association + social enterprise group. Runs Burnley Together (£70K/yr council contract). NOT wholly council-owned — it's a Registered Provider under Housing and Regeneration Act 2008. The '-ELECTIONS' suffix is a finance-system ledger code, not an electoral link (see lessons.md 18 Apr 2026).

Charitable leisure trust commissioned by Burnley BC to run leisure services. Legally separate from the council — an arms-length management contract, not an internal transfer. £12.9M across 335 transactions reflects fees, not a wholly-owned-subsidiary transfer.

usage: Any Lancashire district's record_classification.json may reference this file at aliases.shared_file = '../shared/lancashire_district_aliases.json'. The ETL-level canonicaliser (supplier_canonical.py) does not yet dispatch on these groups — downstream analyses (cross_council, supplier-profile merging) should join on the canonical name via this table until ETL-level alias-merge is wired in.
